title: Origin enrollment stays refused after an unresolved binding recovery leaves a quarantined tail
outcome: Origin enrollment stays refused after an unresolved binding recovery leaves a quarantined tail
acceptance: After an unresolved binding-origin recovery leaves a quarantined binding, ordinary origin enrollment or fork either proceeds, because the settledness check excludes quarantined bindings while keeping their uncertainty visible, or is refused with a typed recovery remedy that names the quarantined binding.
A behavior test reproduces the quarantined-tail case and shows the chosen outcome.
